title: Amber's Sesame Chicken
description: Amber's sesame chicken recipe uses honey, teriyaki sauce, five-spice powder, and red pepper flakes to give this version of the dish a distinctive flavor.
ingredients: 5 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks
0.5 cup green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced

steps.text: Combine flour, 1/4 cup sesame seeds, black pepper, five-spice powder, and red pepper flakes in a large resealable plastic bag. Add chicken pieces, a few at a time, and shake to coat; transfer to a platter. Repeat with remaining chicken pieces.

Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken; brown on both sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate; set aside. Stir onion and bell pepper into skillet; cook until slightly browned, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl; set aside.

Return chicken to the skillet; reduce heat to low. Stir in teriyaki marinade, remaining 1/4 cup sesame seeds, and honey; stir until sauce thickens. Return onion and bell pepper to the skillet; cook until warmed through.
